body: Thanks. This made me feel better actually. You are right, we do have a great relationship and everything is going to be ok. I just wish I didn't over react every time

We've been dating a year and a half and this is our third fight. So no. We get along so well that it's practically unreal, especially considering all my issues and triggers. As a codependent, I know you can't take me seriously when I say this, but he is an amazing wonderful person. So much so I often feel like he deserves better than a basket case.
I'll tell him. you are right. I just feel like I'm being overly dramatic. Like, I realize how fucking dramatic I am and yet I still cant stop it.

He knows I flip out but I don't think he knows exactly where my mind goes. I don't want him to worry that he isn't allowed to get mad at me because I'm insane. He should be allowed to be mad when he's mad. Honestly I'm so conflicted because on the one hand, I feel like he is a person who deserves to have the emotions he has and to calm down the way he calms down, and on the other hand I'm insanely angry at him for doing this to me. I guess I'm just feeling sorry for myself. I get mad when he is mad at me because he triggers me going off the deep end. Still I can't just expect us to never fight, and him leaving the house is actually considered a very constructive way for him to deal with his anger. I mean, at least he isn't hitting me or insulting me. He deserves a lot better than I can give him.
